subject.title: feat(discord): add event-edit and event-delete actions

question: Should Discord scheduled-event edit/delete reuse the existing `channels.discord.actions.events` gate, or require a separate destructive-action gate before merge?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable, but the decision changes operator least-privilege semantics for a destructive Discord action and cannot be inferred safely from CI or the current patch alone.

options.title: Rebase With Explicit Gate Decision
options.body: Require the branch to preserve current requester/permission checks and either document maintainer acceptance of the existing events gate for full lifecycle mutations or implement the chosen split gate.

options.title: Accept Existing Events Gate
options.body: Allow list/create/edit/delete under one events gate, accepting that existing events-enabled deployments gain destructive deletion after upgrade.

options.title: Pause For Granular Gates
options.body: Hold or replace this PR until the broader Discord action-gate model in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/7234 is decided.

recommendation.title: Rebase With Explicit Gate Decision
recommendation.body: Require the branch to preserve current requester/permission checks and either document maintainer acceptance of the existing events gate for full lifecycle mutations or implement the chosen split gate.
